action_items: Backend lane not applicable: the acceptance matrix specifies React session state only and no API/database behavior. The pre-scaffolded backend suite contains no tests (pytest exited 5: no tests ran).

checks.criterion: Beranda membuka alur belajar dan profil hanya meminta nama panggilan/inisial serta kelompok usia
checks.name: profile-starts-learning
checks.evidence: Home hero and CTA visible; nickname Aira and age 2–3 tahun accepted; navigated to /belajar with module card visible.

checks.criterion: Navigasi multi-page utama tersedia dan tidak blank
checks.name: responsive-navigation-pages
checks.evidence: Mobile menu opened, /belajar rendered with progress and page navigation, and mobile horizontal-overflow assertion passed.

checks.criterion: Menu belajar menampilkan 10 kartu materi dan detail materi interaktif
checks.name: learn-material-detail
checks.evidence: 10 module cards counted; material detail rendered with example, accordion details, and completion returned to /belajar.

checks.criterion: Susun Piringku menambah, mengganti, menghapus, mereset, dan mengevaluasi makanan
checks.name: plate-build-evaluate
checks.evidence: Empty-plate validation shown; nasi, telur, wortel, pisang selected; evaluation rendered; selected item removed and reset restored empty plate.

checks.name: snack-switch-feedback
checks.evidence: Try option displayed positive feedback, next example changed progress, and usual option displayed non-judgmental feedback.

checks.criterion: Kuis memberi feedback langsung dan berpindah sampai selesai
checks.name: quiz-completes-with-feedback
checks.evidence: Four choices counted; first answer showed feedback and disabled choice; eight questions advanced to completion card with score.

checks.name: scenario-and-hygiene-checklist
checks.evidence: Four scenario choices counted and option 3 produced feedback; five hygiene items counted and checking all displayed completion message.

checks.criterion: Ringkasan, referensi, aksesibilitas dasar, dan responsive layout
checks.name: summary-and-references
checks.evidence: Five summary reminders rendered; references page showed three official reference cards and disclaimer text.
